title: GTA 6 aaj launch: 1.7 crore pre-orders, price, 212 GB?
hooks: 1.7 crore pre-orders, GTA 6 aaj raat launch
Sabse bada entertainment launch aaj raat 12 baje
212 GB ka game, ₹8000 se shuru, kya khareedoge?
hook_why: Opens with the staggering pre-order number (1.7 crore) and immediate launch timing — the two highest-stakes facts that trigger instant curiosity. Matches the 'Urgent Interruption' hook pattern that wins on Shorts.
metaphor: A digital highway where pre-order cars (1.7 crore) rush toward a launch toll gate at midnight, each car carrying a $80/$100 ticket and a 212 GB cargo — visualizes volume, price tiers, and file size in one moving metaphor.

caption:
1.7 crore pre-orders, $1.65B revenue, 212 GB install. GTA 6 drops tonight 12 AM IST. 🎮

Standard $80 vs Ultimate $100 — India price store pe check karo. PC baad mein aayega.

Tum kaun sa edition khareed rahe ho? Comment mein batao 👇
